45 Further provision about seizure under section 43

(1) Where—
(a) any items which a relevant enforc ement officer wishes to seize and
remove are in a container, and
(b) the officer reasonably considers th at it would facilitate the seizure and
removal of the items if they remained in the container for that purpose,
any power to seize and remove the it ems conferred by section 43 includes
power to seize and remove the container.
